comment: The Filters docker summoned on a fresh profile over a photograph opens wide, the list a sidebar beside the detail, the blur picked with its whole sentence and preview. Moved over the canvas, which the borrow follows, so the Layers docker it opened over takes a press, a blur attached to the photograph and its row pressed in the Layers docker shows its parameters in the right column under Open. Closed and opened again from the Window menu's row, it is summoned locked and wide about the middle of its strip, as the answer of 2026-10-09 asked, in front of the Layers docker the last press was in, and Levels is picked there, since the blur's own panel is up in Tool Options and the browser previews no filter whose page is up. The row pressed again sends it back to the strip. Shown in that strip of the shipped layout, 160 wide, it stands the list over the detail with its own scroll. The browser's dump carries each part's rectangle, so no part over another is read in numbers as well as in the shots.
